speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: A cloak, and two sleeves, for the autumn. I will tell you the terms before you tell me the season. Payment on delivery. No more accounts.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good morning, Edith. Say the work, and then we will say what the stock can bear.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: I have said the work. A cloak and two sleeves. The terms are the rest. I am done keeping a name in a book that pays me when the weather improves.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The season is the trouble, Edith. We do not know the autumn. A company can promise cloth and then find the week will not hold a cloak.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Stop there. The uncertainty is her point. You are describing the weather, and she has already priced the weather out of the bargain.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was going to say we might defer the cloak.

speaker: will_kemp
text: She has deferred you. Pay the woman, or do not order the woman. You, Master Shakespeare, are not her banker, and neither is the sky.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, a cloak. Item, two sleeves. Item, a stock that can pay one of those things today and must not pretend the other. Edith, we accept the terms.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: Say which thing you are buying.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The sleeves, and not the cloak. Six shillings. Payment on delivery. No more accounts. The costume will be less fine. The dealing will be more honest.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Six shillings, and the cloak stays in her shop until someone can say an autumn without blushing. I am with her. You may argue the poetry after she has gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: John, the sleeves will do. I do not want a cloak we cannot stand behind. I began in the wrong place.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: The cloak is a winter's work. I will not cut it against a June promise.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: You began where men begin, Master Shakespeare. In a hope. I do not sew hopes.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The order is written as I said it. Sleeves. Six shillings. You will be paid when you bring them, and not before, and not in a promise.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: Pay me in coin, Master Heminges, and you may pay the weather in promises.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Write that on the paper, John. I want it where a poet can see it and not improve it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It is the terms. I do not need a fair copy of a sentence I have just accepted. Edith, the sleeves. We will not add the cloak by a back stair.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: Then I will not cut the cloak. Two sleeves. Six shillings. On the day I put them in your hand, you put the coin in mine. If the day is never, you owe me nothing, and I owe you no cloth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Six shillings, when the sleeves are in his hand. Not from me. From the stock.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is fair. I am sorry I made a speech of it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You are sorry in the right direction, which is a feast day for you. Let her go. She has thread to buy, and we have a morning that is not about our feelings.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: I will bring the sleeves when they are sleeves. Do not send me a boy with a reason. Send the coin, or send nothing.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nothing, until the day. Thank you, Edith. The morning is yours.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And if any sharer tells this story as if we were generous, send him to me. We were late, and we were specific. Six shillings. Not a cloak.
